sources.title: GitHub - mee0011/Bangla-AI-Text-Detector
sources.snippet: 📝 Bangla AI Text Detector A high-performance deep learning application designed to distinguish between human-written and AI-generated (e.g., ChatGPT, GPT-4) Bengali text. This project utilizes a fine-tuned BanglaBERT model to capture the nuances of Bengali syntax and semantics.

sources.title: Bengali AI Detector - Evernote
sources.snippet: Can it detect AI in Bengali? Yes, the detector analyzes Bengali text for AI-generated patterns, offering insights through probability scores and detailed indications of AI or human characteristics.
